description: This file contains utility functions for creating and managing meshes in TensorFlow's DTensor system, including functions to create both single-client and distributed meshes, handle device specifications, and run synchronization barriers across mesh devices.

classes.name: layout.Mesh
classes.description: Represents a computational mesh for distributed tensor computations, including device IDs, dimensions, and mesh name.

methods.name: None _print_context(num_global_devices: int, num_clients: int, client_id: int, device_type: str, mesh: layout.Mesh)
methods.description: Logs information about the mesh context, including client ID, number of clients, device type, and mesh device IDs.

methods.name: Tuple[List[tf_device.DeviceSpec],str] _make_device_specs( devices: Optional[List[Union[tf_device.DeviceSpec, str]]] = None, device_type: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Generates device specifications from provided device list or device type, handling both string and DeviceSpec inputs.

methods.name: layout.Mesh create_mesh( mesh_dims: Optional[Union[List[Tuple[str, int]], Dict[str, int]]] = None, mesh_name: str = '', devices: Optional[List[Union[tf_device.DeviceSpec, str]]] = None, device_type: Optional[str] = None, use_xla_spmd: bool = layout.USE_XLA_SPMD, )
methods.description: Creates a single-client computational mesh with specified dimensions, devices, and options.

methods.name: layout.Mesh create_distributed_mesh( mesh_dims: Union[List[Tuple[str, int]], Dict[str, int]], mesh_name: str = '', local_devices: Optional[List[Union[tf_device.DeviceSpec, str]]] = None, device_type: Optional[str] = None, use_xla_spmd: bool = layout.USE_XLA_SPMD, )
methods.description: Creates a distributed mesh spanning multiple clients, supporting CPU, GPU, and TPU device types.

methods.name: barrier(mesh: layout.Mesh, barrier_name: Optional[str] = None, timeout_in_ms: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Synchronizes all devices within a mesh by running a collective barrier operation, ensuring completion of prior tasks.
